**Questions** <!-- pr-review v5.6 -->
Author: 1 question.

**For Author:**
1. These changes are outside this review. Overdue invoices get a late fee after thirty days, on by default ([`send.ts` L13-L16](https://github.com/example/repo/blob/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/src/notify/send.ts#L13-L16)).
   **What sign-off does this change to billing, plans, credits or pricing need before it merges?**
   A. Author states in the PR description what changes for customers: a short written account puts on record what customers will see
   B. A person who owns billing reviews the changes: they know the pricing rules this touches
   C. Whoever owns pricing has already agreed to it, so merge: when the sign-off happened outside this PR
   **Recommended: A.** One paragraph from Author puts on record what customers will see, and nobody has to read code.
